# Tyan Lee

> Tyan Lee is a Postbaccalaureate Researcher at Stanford's Institute for Research in the Social Sciences (IRiSS). Tyan holds a B.A. with Honors in Economics from Stanford University (2026) and studies the effects of policy on socioeconomically disadvantaged populations in the United States, with current work on homelessness policy.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://tyanlee.github.io/tyan-site/): introduction, research areas, and email address
- [Bio & C.V.](https://tyanlee.github.io/tyan-site/bio/): biography, education, and research experience
- [Research](https://tyanlee.github.io/tyan-site/publication/): work in progress, honors thesis, and presentations

## Research areas

- Homelessness policy
- Inequality and heterogeneity in macroeconomics
